definitions.explanation: A substance that is part of a mixture or compound; the elements that make up something.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成分|せいぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦してください→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Please check the ingredients of this medicine.

examples.japanese: {成分|せいぶん}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っているか→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: If you look at the ingredient list, you can see what's in it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{成分|せいぶん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Only natural ingredients are used in this cosmetic product.

notes:
{成分|せいぶん} refers to the components or ingredients that make up a substance. It's commonly used for food, medicine, cosmetics, and chemical compounds.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {成分|せいぶん}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: ingredient listing
- {成分|せいぶん}⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧: component analysis
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧{成分|せいぶん}: active ingredient
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧{成分|せいぶん}: nutritional components
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{成分|せいぶん}: natural ingredients

USAGE:
- Food labels
- Medicine/pharmaceutical information
- Cosmetics
- Chemical analysis
